0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_TALK_ACTOR_02
0.description: You wish to teach <hex:022903EA0203> an ability, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? Then, if you would be so kind as to provide the requisite manual.

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_001_DONE
1.description: I can say with confidence that your race chocobo responded well to the <hex:022818FF1343686F636F626F526163654162696C697479E8020103> training. Pray judge for yourself, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_TALK_ACTOR
2.description: You wish to teach your race chocobo an ability, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? Then, if you would be so kind as to provide the requisite manual.

3.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_001_01
3.description: ...But, more importantly, should you not first register your race chocobo?

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_001_02
4.description: Race chocobos cannot be taught abilities until they have been officially registered.

5.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_002_01
5.description: ...I gather from your expression that you do not have a training manual?

6.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_002_02
6.description: Race abilities cannot be taught without the requisite manuals, which can be purchased from the tack & feed trader at the race counter.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_003_01
7.description: Hmmm... While I understand your desire to train the finest race chocobo possible, I fear you overestimate your steed's capabilities...

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_003_02
8.description: Your race chocobo must unlearn an ability before you can teach it a new one.

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_004_01
9.description: A bold strategy, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, but a futile one, I fear. Chocobos lack the capacity to differentiate between such similar abilities.

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_004_02
10.description: Your race chocobo cannot learn two abilities of the same type.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEGETABILITY_00228_ERROR_004_03
11.description: If you wish to teach your chocobo a more powerful version of a learned ability, you must first have it unlearn the weaker version.
